product_family: iZotope RX: AI-powered audio restoration and post-production software suite, including Scene Rebalance, Music Rebalance, Dialogue Isolate, Repair Assistant, and other ML-based audio repair modules for professional audio engineers and content creators.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public SOC 2 certification found on iZotope.com or Native Instruments trust center pages. Web searches for iZotope SOC 2 yielded no vendor-domain results.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public ISO 27001 certification found on iZotope.com or Native Instruments trust center pages. Web searches for iZotope ISO 27001 yielded no vendor-domain results.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA compliance mentioned in privacy policy, terms of use, or enterprise security documentation. iZotope RX is a creative software tool, not marketed for healthcare data.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO/IEC 42001 or AI governance certification found. iZotope RX uses ML-powered features but no AI-specific compliance framework is publicly documented.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance Posture
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy states Native Instruments USA complies with European data protection laws and designates a Data Protection Officer (boston-legal@native-instruments.com). GDPR is referenced as a regulatory compliance requirement, not a formal certification.

certifications.name: CCPA Compliance Posture
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy acknowledges CCPA requirements for California residents and provides 'Do Not Share My Personal Information' opt-out mechanism per California law.

privacy.ai_training_note: RX includes ML-powered Repair Assistant, Scene Rebalance, and generative fill features. Privacy policy and product documentation do not explicitly disclose whether customer audio processed by RX is used to train or improve the AI models. Usage Information collection excludes audio files (per license agreement), but policy does not clarify whether model inference on customer audio constitutes data usage for training. Flag: Transparency gap on AI model training data sources.
privacy.data_region: United States (primary), offices in Germany and United Kingdom. Data may be transferred internationally.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Website uses HTTPS. Specific encryption protocols for data transmission not disclosed.

security.name: Data safeguards
security.value: Policy states 'We employ a number of technical, organizational and physical safeguards designed to protect the personal information we collect' but details not provided. Disclaimer: 'security risk is inherent in all Internet and information technologies, and we cannot guarantee the security of your personal information.'

security.name: Third-party security requirements
security.value: iZotope requires third parties to respect security of personal data and comply with law. Third-party processors include Google Analytics and Mixpanel.

security.name: Account security
security.value: iZotope strengthened security measures to block login credentials found in known public data breaches. Native ID login system now shared across Native Instruments and iZotope products.

products.name: iZotope RX 12 Advanced
products.data_scope: Processes audio files locally (desktop software). Audio files not uploaded by default. Usage telemetry collected at aggregate level only.
products.notes: Full-featured AI-powered audio repair suite. Includes Scene Rebalance, Music Rebalance, Dialogue Isolate, Repair Assistant 3.0 with generative fill capability. Perpetual license or subscription available.

products.name: iZotope RX 12 Elements
products.data_scope: Lightweight version, local processing. Same aggregated usage telemetry as Advanced.
products.notes: Entry-level AI audio repair focused on noise reduction and restoration. Subset of RX 12 Advanced features.

products.name: iZotope RX Post Production Suite
products.data_scope: Bundles RX with other post-production tools (Ozone, Neutron, etc.). Local processing for all components.
products.notes: Multi-product bundle for film/TV post-production workflows. Includes AI-powered and traditional mixing/mastering tools.

compare.pricing_model: Perpetual license (one-time purchase) or subscription (monthly/annual access to latest version). Upgrades available. Educational and volume licensing discounts available.
compare.data_residency: United States (primary). Data may be transferred to Germany, UK, or other countries. No data residency guarantees found.

flags: No public SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications — typical for creative software vendor, not a SaaS platform
AI training data sources not disclosed — unclear whether iZotope uses customer audio data to train or improve ML models
Broad security disclaimer in privacy policy: 'cannot guarantee the security of personal information'
User-submitted feedback becomes iZotope's unrestricted property with worldwide sublicenseable rights per Terms of Use
No formal Data Processing Agreement (DPA) found publicly for enterprise customers
International data transfers mentioned but no data residency or transfer mechanism agreements documented publicly
Third-party data sharing with Google Analytics and Mixpanel for usage telemetry
No AI governance framework (ISO/IEC 42001 or equivalent) documented
